surface: Standalone, reproducible PNG figures accompanying static full-page design concepts in the existing review gallery. These are not an HTML report or dashboard.
validation: All 277 removal outcomes independently checked by traversing the supplied graph; named stranded groups and 1000-row shuffle histogram checked against source files.

charts.question: How often does removing one article fragment the remaining connected core?
charts.takeaway: 264 of 277 removals leave the other 276 articles connected; 13 cause fragmentation.
charts.variant: 277-unit matrix plus directly labeled ranked horizontal bars for the 13 nonzero outcomes
charts.grain: One single-article removal from the same 277-article connected core
charts.palette: Single cobalt root plus neutrals; circle versus square and explicit group labels
charts.scales: Count bars start at zero and end at five; one matrix mark per experiment, sorted by outcome

charts.question: Which articles are stranded by removing Black Widow, and do they remain connected to each other?
charts.takeaway: Three stranded articles form two groups: Blue Eagle alone and Rockman connected to The Witness.
charts.variant: Fixed-position before/after component schematic with a collapsed 273-article core
charts.grain: Actual local links around one removal; no geometric distance or area encoding
charts.rows: 277 nodes and 1421 undirected edges, reduced to explicitly labeled groups
charts.palette: Hard two-root cap, cobalt for the main group and orange for stranded nodes; labels, separate enclosures and removal cross
charts.scales: Schematic topology; grouped shapes are not proportional to article count. All three affected links verified.

charts.question: How unusual is Spider-Man's five-article stranding result among the recorded degree-preserving shuffles?
charts.takeaway: 9 of 1000 shuffled trials strand at least five articles; the observed result is unusual under this descriptive comparison.
charts.variant: Discrete histogram with an observed-value marker and patterned highlighted tail
charts.grain: One connected degree-preserving shuffled network, then Spider-Man removed
charts.palette: Hard two-root cap, cobalt and orange; hatching, direct labels and observed-value annotation
charts.scales: Linear count y-axis from zero; discrete integer x-axis 0 to 5
charts.caveat: Shuffles are connected before removal. Exploratory finite-chain comparison; 9/1000 is an empirical count, not proof of a cause or a calibrated significance claim.
